caption: Most people build the posting bot before they build the thing that makes a post worth publishing. Five failures I'd fix in this order. Which one got you? 👇
caption_fb: Most people build the posting bot before they build the thing that makes a post worth publishing. Here are the five failures worth fixing first — in order.
first_comment: The carousel publish flow trips up almost everyone: it's three API calls, not two.

slides.headline: 5 ways your first Instagram automation dies
slides.subhead: Every one of these is a *silent* failure. The job keeps running. Nothing gets posted.
slides.alt: Cover slide reading: 5 ways your first Instagram automation dies

slides.headline: You wrote the two-call publish flow
slides.body: A single image is two calls. A *carousel is three* — one child container per slide, then a parent, then publish. Miss it and you ship one lonely slide.
slides.alt: Slide 1: the carousel publish flow is three API calls, not two

slides.headline: Your images live on your laptop
slides.body: Meta fetches image_url from *its* servers, not yours. Local paths fail. So do private buckets. And Instagram wants JPEG — most pipelines emit PNG.
slides.alt: Slide 2: images must be publicly reachable JPEGs

slides.headline: posts per rolling 24 hours
slides.body: Enforced at publish, not at container creation. A carousel counts as one. Most guides still quote the old number.
slides.alt: Slide 3: the publishing limit is 100 posts per rolling 24 hours

slides.headline: The token quietly expired
slides.body: A 60-day token means a 60-day timer on your whole system. Use a Business Manager *system user* token instead — it doesn't expire.
slides.alt: Slide 4: use a non-expiring system user token

slides.headline: You asked a model to spell
slides.body: Image models draw letters, they don't set type. Render slides in HTML and screenshot them: *perfect spelling*, exact brand colour, free re-renders.
slides.alt: Slide 5: render slide text in HTML rather than generating it

slides.headline: The order I'd build it in
items: Account chain and a token that never expires
Brand tokens — one file everything reads
Publish to both platforms from the terminal
Only then: let a model choose the topic
slides.alt: Slide 6: recommended build order, five steps

slides.quote: Automation is throughput. Measurement is the only part that compounds.
slides.alt: Slide 7: pull quote about measurement compounding

slides.headline: The whole build, eight phases
slides.body: Every API call, both platforms, and the twelve improvements that matter — written up in full.
slides.alt: Final slide: comment BUILD for the full teardown
